about: A desktop app for testing and load testing web APIs, similar to Postman.

prs.title: Imported form data turns + into a space
prs.broken: Pasting a browser's "Copy as cURL" kept + signs in form fields, so "hello world" was sent as "hello+world".
prs.changed: Form data from imported commands now reads + as a space, while query data sent with -G stays as it was.
prs.matters: Requests copied from the browser send the same data the browser did.
